english: a matter of life and death
also: it’s not a question of life or death
not the end of the world

terms.gloss: a matter of life and death
terms.grammar: rēs with the genitive of caput, “life”
evidence: Plaut. Trin. 4.2.120: sī capitis rēs siet, if it is a matter of life and death (Lewis & Short), s.v. caput
terms.comment: Caput is a person’s life and civil standing; agitur is “is at stake”.

phrases.english: It’s not a question of life or death.

sources: Lewis & Short: caput
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 102, checked against the searchable text and the page image (12 November 2026).
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
